preconditions.description: The number of shamans N must be between 2 and 100000.
The maximum number of trusted friends D must be between 1 and 500.
The number of days U must be between 0 and 200000.
The number of questions Q must be between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H_i <= 10**9 for H_i in H)
preconditions.description: Each altitude H_i must be between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i < N and 0 <= B_i < N and A_i != B_i for A_i, B_i in updates)
preconditions.description: Each pair of shamans (A_i, B_i) must be valid indices and distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if any(x' == y' for x' in trusted_friends(x, v) for y' in trusted_friends(y, v)) else True
postconditions.description: If there is a trusted friend common to both x and y on day v, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1000000000' if not trusted_friends(x, v) or not trusted_friends(y, v) else True
postconditions.description: If either x or y has no trusted friends on day v, the output must be 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min(abs(H[x'] - H[y']) for x' in trusted_friends(x, v) for y' in trusted_friends(y, v))) if trusted_friends(x, v) and trusted_friends(y, v) else True
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum distance between the altitudes of trusted friends of x and y on day v.
